description: Build-time Microsoft Sentinel native-table destination knowledge for Cribl pack generation.
reliabilityRules: Sentinel is a platform, not a schema: require a specific table before mapping.
Emit flat top-level fields whose names and types exactly match the selected DCR stream declaration.
Set TimeGenerated to an ISO-8601 UTC datetime derived from the source event time; use ingestion time only as an explicit fallback.
Use the DCR input stream (Custom-<Table>) in the Cribl Sentinel destination and the DCR output stream (Microsoft-<Table>) only as Azure routing metadata.
Do not serialize the event into _raw for a structured DCR stream; the Sentinel destination serializes the top-level event object.
Remove unknown fields before delivery unless the selected table explicitly provides an overflow column such as AdditionalExtensions.
Coerce int, long, real, boolean, datetime, dynamic, and string values to the declared Azure type before cleanup.
Treat solution DCR transformKql as higher-authority mapping knowledge than generic aliases, while hand-verified mappings remain highest priority.
Validate the generated pack against the deployed DCR because this catalog is a versioned snapshot and the upstream templates are deprecated.

destinationContract.secretRule: Never commit client secrets; reference a Cribl secret or environment-specific secure value.
